lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We left the Bustling Market, and now we're on wide green plains. Whoosh! Can you feel it? The wind is very strong here. Welcome to the Windy Plains! Today's sentence is: The wind is blowing. Say it with me. The wind is blowing. Great! When something is happening right now, we say is and then a word with i-n-g. The wind is blowing. The grass is moving. いま おきている ことは、is と ～ing で いうよ。 Now, phonics. Make, making. Wave, waving. Smile, smiling. Shine, shining. These words end with a quiet e. Take away the e, and add i-n-g. e で おわる ことばは、e を とって ing。 Good job! Here's a tip for windy days. If your hat flies away, shout, My hat is flying away! Let's say it together. My hat is flying away! OK, hold on to your hats, everyone. Let's walk up the hill and look around!

segments.say: Today's goal. Say what is happening right now. The wind is blowing. The grass is moving. いま の ことは is と ing!

segments.say: Wind. Whoosh! You can't see it, but you can feel it on your face. Wind!

segments.subtitleEn: Plains. Wide, flat land with grass everywhere. Plains!

segments.say: Grass. Green and soft. It tickles your toes. Grass!
segments.subtitleJa: grass。みどりで やわらかい。あしの ゆびが くすぐったい。grass！
segments.subtitleEn: Grass. Green and soft. It tickles your toes. Grass!

segments.say: Hill. Up, up, up, and then down again. Hill!

segments.say: Here's the point. Is plus ing tells us it's happening right now. The wind is blowing. My hat is flying away! is を わすれないでね.

segments.subtitleEn: Here's the point. Is plus ing tells us it's happening right now. The wind is blowing. My hat is flying away!

segments.say: Sound time! Make, wave, smile, and shine end with a quiet E. Add ing, and the E says bye-bye. Making. Waving. Smiling. Shining.
segments.subtitleJa: おとの じかん！ make、wave、smile、shine は さいごに しずかな e が あるね。ing を つけると、e が バイバイ。making、waving、smiling、shining。

segments.say: Your turn. Let the ing ring in your nose. Making. Waving. Smiling. Shining.

segments.subtitleEn: Your turn. Let the ing ring in your nose. Making. Waving. Smiling. Shining.

segments.say: Let's move! The wind is getting stronger. Hold your hat. Both hands on your head! Now, lean into the wind. Push, push!
segments.subtitleJa: からだを うごかそう！ かぜが つよく なってきた。ぼうしを おさえて。りょうてを あたまに！ つぎは かぜに むかって からだを たおして。ぐいっ、ぐいっ！

segments.say: Speed challenge! Lean into the wind! Smile at the sky! Hold your hat! Wave your arms! You're windy champions!

segments.say: Repeat after me. The wind is blowing.
segments.subtitleJa: まねして いってね。「かぜが ふいています。」
segments.subtitleEn: Repeat after me. The wind is blowing.

segments.say: The grass is moving.
segments.subtitleJa: 「くさが ゆれています。」
segments.subtitleEn: The grass is moving.

segments.say: Oh no! My hat is flying away!
segments.subtitleJa: 「あっ！ わたしの ぼうしが とんでいく！」
segments.subtitleEn: Oh no! My hat is flying away!

segments.say: Your turn! Imagine you're on the plains. What is moving? My hair is moving. A leaf is flying. Say one thing!
segments.subtitleJa: あなたの ばん！ そうげんに いると おもってね。なにが うごいてる？ My hair is moving.（かみが ゆれてる）。A leaf is flying.（はっぱが とんでる）。ひとつ いってみて！
segments.subtitleEn: Your turn! Imagine you're on the plains. What is moving? My hair is moving. A leaf is flying. Say one thing!

segments.say: Quiz time! The wind is strong right now. A, The wind blowing. Or B, The wind is blowing. Which one? Think!
segments.subtitleJa: クイズ！ いま かぜが つよいよ。A「The wind blowing.」 B「The wind is blowing.」 どっち？ かんがえて！
segments.subtitleEn: Quiz time! The wind is strong right now. A, The wind blowing. Or B, The wind is blowing. Which one? Think!

segments.say: It's B! For right now, use is plus ing. You caught that answer just like Kiko caught the hat. Super!
segments.subtitleJa: こたえは B！ いま の ことは is と ing。キコちゃんが ぼうしを つかまえたみたいに、こたえを つかまえたね。すごい！
segments.subtitleEn: It's B! For right now, use is plus ing. You caught that answer just like Kiko caught the hat. Super!

segments.say: Great job! You can say the wind is blowing and the grass is moving. And you can add ing to make and smile. Next, talk with Riko! リコちゃん と おはなし してね. Hold on to your hat. See you!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! It's a perfect day for kites. The wind is strong, and the sky is blue. Riko is on the hill. Haru wants to know what she's doing. Today's sentence is: What are you doing? Say it with me. What are you doing? Good! And Riko answers, I'm flying a kite. Say it. I'm flying a kite. I'm is I am. I'm flying means I am flying right now. 「なにを しているの？」は What are you doing? こたえは I'm ～ing. だよ。 Now, phonics. Ride, riding. Hide, hiding. Slide, sliding. Write, writing. Do you remember? When a word ends with e, take the e away and add i-n-g. Excellent! Here's a talking tip. When your friend tells you what they're doing, you can say, That looks fun! Let's say it. That looks fun! Now, let's grab our kites and run up the hill. Ready? Let's fly!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today there's a race on the plains. Ready, set, go! Kiko is very fast. Haru is fast, too. When we talk about another person, we say he's or she's. Today's sentence is: Look! She's running fast. Say it with me. Look! She's running fast. Great! She's means she is. He's means he is. ほかの 人が いま している ことは、He's ～ing. / She's ～ing. で いうよ。 Start with Look! Then everyone looks at the same thing. This is how sports reporters talk. They're telling us what's happening now. Now, phonics. Dance, dancing. Race, racing. Chase, chasing. Bounce, bouncing. These words end with c-e or s-e. Take away the e and add i-n-g. Here's a cheering tip. When your friend is running, shout, Go, go, go! You can do it! Let's cheer together. Go, go, go! You can do it! OK, reporters, get your voices ready. The race is starting!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today we're having a picnic on the plains. The sun is shining, and the wind is soft today. Ms. Emma wants to know if everyone is happy. Today's sentence is: Are you having fun? Say it with me. Are you having fun? Wonderful! To make a question, put are at the front. You are having fun. Are you having fun? The answer is, Yes, I am! or No, I'm not. Are you ～ing? と きかれたら、Yes, I am. か No, I'm not. で こたえよう。 Now, phonics. Have, having. Come, coming. Give, giving. Share, sharing. Even these short words drop the e. Have becomes having. Here's a picnic tip. When you want to share your food, say, Do you want some? Let's say it. Do you want some? Now, let's spread the blanket and open our lunch boxes. Are you hungry? Yes, I am!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today Ms. Emma is in town, and you're on the plains. Let's give her a video call. On a video call, your friend can't see everything. So tell them what you're doing. Today's sentence is: I'm sitting on a hill. Say it with me. I'm sitting on a hill. Great! You can also say we. We're watching the clouds. We're means we are. And ask back, What are you doing now? ビデオ通話では、I'm ～ing. で いまの ようすを つたえよう。 Now, phonics review. Skate, skating. Dive, diving. These drop the e. Jump, jumping. Play, playing. These just add i-n-g. Look at the last letter! Here's an important tip for video calls. You can talk about what you're doing, but don't say your address or your school's name. じゅうしょや がっこうの なまえは いわないでね。 OK, hold up your tablets. Let's call Ms. Emma!

phonics.tipJa: trot → trotting、hop → hopping、sit → sitting、nap → napping。みじかい 母音＋子音 1つで おわるときは、さいごの 子音を 2つに して ing。

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today we're visiting a farm on the plains. There are horses, sheep and cows. Let's watch the animals quietly. When two or more animals are doing something, we use are. Today's sentence is: The horses are eating grass. Say it with me. The horses are eating grass. Good! You can also say they. They're trotting slowly. They're means they are. ふたつ いじょうなら are、または they're を つかうよ。 Now, new phonics! Trot, trotting. Hop, hopping. Sit, sitting. Nap, napping. These words are short. They have one short vowel and one last consonant. So we double the last letter. Sit becomes s-i-t-t-i-n-g. みじかい 母音と 子音 ひとつで おわる ことばは、さいごの もじを ふたつに するよ。 Here's a tip for animal watching. When you see something cute, whisper, Aww, so cute! Let's whisper. Aww, so cute! Now, let's walk to the fence slowly. Don't run, or the horses will be scared.

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! The animals on the plains are playing hide-and-seek. Can you find them? Look carefully. Today's sentence is: The rabbit is behind the rock. Say it with me. The rabbit is behind the rock. Great! Behind means at the back. In front of means at the front. Now it's in front of the rock! And next to means right beside. A fox is next to the tree. behind は うしろ、in front of は まえ、next to は となり だよ。 Use your hands to show the places. Behind. In front of. Next to. Now, phonics. Run, running. Stop, stopping. Drop, dropping. Skip, skipping. One short vowel, one last consonant. Double it! Then add i-n-g. Here's a game tip. When you find someone, say, I found you! Let's say it. I found you! OK, let's be quiet like detectives and look for the animals. Shh!

The bird is between the trees. Good! Between means in the middle of two things. You can say, between the big tree and the small tree. Between A and B. between は ふたつの ものの あいだ だよ。 Let's review the place words. Behind. In front of. Next to. Between. Show me with your hands! Now, phonics. Flap, flapping. Spin, spinning. Get, getting. Step, stepping. Short vowel, one consonant. Double the last letter, and add i-n-g. Here's a tip for bird watching. If you can't find it, ask, Where is the bird now? Let's ask. Where is the bird now? OK, get your binoculars. Step quietly, and let's find that bird!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! There's a big friendly dog on the farm. Its name is Pochi. Pochi is very busy today. Let's watch. To ask about an animal, say, What is the dog doing? Say it with me. What is the dog doing? Good! The answer starts with It's. It's digging. It's means it is. For animals, we often say it. どうぶつの ことは It's ～ing. で こたえるよ。 You can also ask a yes or no question. Is it wagging its tail? Yes, it is. Or, No, it isn't. Now, phonics. Dig, digging. Wag, wagging. Jog, jogging. Grab, grabbing. Can you see the double letters? g-g, g-g, g-g, b-b. Great job! Here's a tip. When a dog comes to you, ask the owner first. Can I pet your dog? Let's say it. lessons.teacherScript: Congratulations, everyone! We watched so many animals this week. Now, let's give an animal watching report. A good report has three sentences. Tell us what the animals are doing, and where they are. Today's sentences are: The cows are sleeping. The lambs are jumping. Say them with me. The cows are sleeping. The lambs are jumping. Excellent! Add a place, too. A bird is sitting between the trees. 3つの 文で、どうぶつが なにを していて、どこに いるか を いおう。 Now, phonics review. Swim, swimming. Clap, clapping. Double the letter. Hide, hiding. Drop the e. lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! The children on the plains are playing soccer. They ask us to join them. Let's play! Today we're learning two kinds of sentences. Listen. I play soccer every day. That's a habit. いつも する こと だよ. I'm playing soccer now. That's happening right now. いま している こと だよ。 Say them with me. I play soccer every day. I'm playing soccer now. Great! Every day, usually and on Sundays go with I play. Now and look go with I'm playing. Can you hear the difference? Now, new phonics. Classroom. Class and room. Playground. Play and ground. Homework. Home and work. Weekend. Week and end. Two words become one word. 2つの ことばが くっついて いるよ。 Here's a team tip. When your friend wants to play, say, Come and join us! Let's say it. Come and join us! OK, lace up your shoes. Let's play some soccer!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Today we have a mini soccer game. Our team plays against the Plains team. In a game, players talk a lot. Today's sentences are: Pass the ball! Nice try! Say them with me. Pass the ball! Nice try! Great! Pass the ball means kick it to me. Nice try means you didn't make it, but it was a good try. おしい！は Nice try! だよ。 When nobody is near you, shout, I'm open! Over here! When your friend makes a good pass, say, Good pass! Now, phonics. Goalkeeper. Goal and keeper. Teammate. Team and mate. Baseball. Base and ball. Basketball. Basket and ball. Long words are easy if you split them. Here's an important tip. Good teammates always say kind words, even when they lose. Say, Nice try! and Good game! Let's say them. Nice try! Good game! OK, team. Let's go!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! There's a marathon on the plains today. Riko is running in it. It's a long race, and she's getting tired. Let's cheer for her. Today's sentence is: Keep going! You can do it! Say it with me. Keep going! You can do it! Wonderful! Keep going means don't stop, continue. そのまま つづけて、という いみ だよ。 You can also say, Don't give up! And near the end, You're almost there! Cheering words give people power. Use a big voice and a big smile. Now, phonics. Sunglasses. Sun and glasses. Downhill. Down and hill. Raincoat. Rain and coat. Grasshopper. Grass and hopper. A grasshopper is an insect that hops in the grass! Here's a tip. After the race, tell the runner, You did it! I'm proud of you! Let's say it. You did it! OK, find a good spot by the road. The runners are coming!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! It's the tug-of-war contest on the plains. The red team and the blue team are pulling a long rope. Pull! Pull! Today's sentence is: Who's winning? Say it with me. Who's winning? Good! Who's means who is. Who is winning? The answer is short. The red team is. You don't need to say winning again. どっちが かってる？ と きかれたら、The red team is. と みじかく こたえよう。 You can also cheer, Everyone is pulling hard! Everyone is one word, and it uses is. Now, phonics. Everyone. Every and one. Something. Some and thing. Outside. Out and side. Sunflower. Sun and flower. Split them, and read them. Here's a tip for contests. When the other team wins, say, Congratulations! Let's say it. Congratulations! OK, choose a team. Red or blue? Hold the rope tightly with both hands. Let's pull!

segments.subtitleJa: やあ、みんな！ きいて。ひいて！ ひいて！ そうげんの つなひき大会だよ。赤チームと 青チームが ながい つなを もっているよ。どっちが かつかな？ みてみよう！
segments.subtitleEn: Hi, everyone! Listen. Pull! Pull! It's the tug-of-war contest on the plains. The red team and the blue team are holding a long rope. Who will win? Let's watch!

segments.say: Today's goal. Ask about a game. Who's winning? Keep the answer short. The red team is. Who's は who is. No need to say winning again!
segments.subtitleJa: きょうの ゴール。しあいの ことを きこう。Who's winning? こたえは みじかく。The red team is。Who's は who is。winning を もう いちど いわなくて いいよ！
segments.subtitleEn: Today's goal. Ask about a game. Who's winning? Keep the answer short. The red team is. No need to say winning again!

segments.say: Tug-of-war. Two teams pull one rope. Heave, ho! Tug-of-war!
segments.subtitleJa: tug-of-war。2つの チームが 1本の つなを ひっぱる。よいしょ！ tug-of-war！
segments.subtitleEn: Tug-of-war. Two teams pull one rope. Heave, ho! Tug-of-war!

segments.say: Rope. Long and strong. Hold it tight! Rope!
segments.subtitleJa: rope。ながくて じょうぶ。しっかり にぎって！ rope！
segments.subtitleEn: Rope. Long and strong. Hold it tight! Rope!

segments.say: Win. Be number one. Hooray! win は かつ. Win!
segments.subtitleJa: win。1ばんに なる。ばんざい！ win は「かつ」。win！
segments.subtitleEn: Win. Be number one. Hooray! Win!

segments.say: Red team. Red shirts, red caps, red flags. Go, red team! Red team!
segments.subtitleJa: red team。赤い シャツ、赤い ぼうし、赤い はた。がんばれ、赤チーム！ red team！
segments.subtitleEn: Red team. Red shirts, red caps, red flags. Go, red team! Red team!

segments.say: Let's listen. I say, Ready? Pull! Birimo shouts, Wow! Everyone is pulling hard! Who's winning? Kiko answers, The red team is! Haru and Riko are on the red team.
segments.subtitleJa: きいてね。わたし「よーい、ひいて！」 ビリモ「わあ！ みんな いっしょうけんめい ひっぱってる！ どっちが かってる？」 キコちゃん「赤チーム！ ハルくんと リコちゃんは 赤チームだよ。」
segments.subtitleEn: Let's listen. I say, Ready? Pull! Birimo shouts, Wow! Everyone is pulling hard! Who's winning? Kiko answers, The red team is! Haru and Riko are on the red team.

slide.title: Talk
items: Wow! Everyone is pulling hard! Who's winning?
The red team is! Haru and Riko are on the red team.

segments.say: Haru grunts, Pull, Riko! We can win! Birimo gasps. Oh! Now the blue team is winning! Who's winning now? At last, Kiko says, The red team won! Congratulations, red team! And everyone claps for the blue team, too. Good game!
segments.subtitleJa: ハルくん「ひいて、リコちゃん！ かてるよ！」 ビリモ「あっ！ こんどは 青チームが かってる！ いまは どっち？」 さいごに キコちゃん「赤チームの かち！ 赤チーム、おめでとう！」 そして みんな 青チームにも はくしゅ。いい しあい！
segments.subtitleEn: Haru grunts, Pull, Riko! We can win! Birimo gasps. Oh! Now the blue team is winning! Who's winning now? At last, Kiko says, The red team won! Congratulations, red team! And everyone claps for the blue team, too. Good game!

slide.title: Talk
items: Oh! Now the blue team is winning! Who's winning now?
The red team won! Congratulations, red team!

segments.say: Here's the point. Who's winning? The red team is. Short and quick! Everyone is one word, and it takes is. Everyone is pulling hard! everyone は is.
segments.subtitleJa: ポイント。Who's winning? The red team is。みじかく すばやく！ everyone は 1つの ことばで、is を つかうよ。Everyone is pulling hard! everyone は is。
segments.subtitleEn: Here's the point. Who's winning? The red team is. Short and quick! Everyone is one word, and it takes is. Everyone is pulling hard!

segments.say: Sound time! Two words make one word again. Every plus one, everyone. Some plus thing, something. Clap the two parts!
segments.subtitleJa: おとの じかん！ また 2つの ことばで 1つの ことば。every と one で everyone。some と thing で something。2つの ぶぶんで てを たたこう！
segments.subtitleEn: Sound time! Two words make one word again. Every plus one, everyone. Some plus thing, something. Clap the two parts!

segments.say: Your turn. Everyone. Something. Outside. Sunflower. Out plus side, sun plus flower. That sunflower is smiling at you!
segments.subtitleJa: あなたの ばん。everyone、something、outside、sunflower。out と side、sun と flower。ひまわりが あなたに にっこり！
segments.subtitleEn: Your turn. Everyone. Something. Outside. Sunflower. Out plus side, sun plus flower. That sunflower is smiling at you!

segments.say: Let's move! Grab your side of the rope. Hold the rope. Now, pull hard! Lean back, lean back!
segments.subtitleJa: からだを うごかそう！ じぶんの がわの つなを つかんで。つなを もって。つぎは つよく ひいて！ うしろへ、うしろへ！
segments.subtitleEn: Let's move! Grab your side of the rope. Hold the rope. Now, pull hard! Lean back, lean back!

segments.say: Don't slide! Dig in your heels. Strong legs! Oops, the rope slips. Fall down softly. Gently, gently.
segments.subtitleJa: すべらないで！ かかとで ふんばって。つよい あし！ おっと、つなが すべった。やさしく たおれて。そっと、そっと。
segments.subtitleEn: Don't slide! Dig in your heels. Strong legs! Oops, the rope slips. Fall down softly. Gently, gently.

segments.say: Speed challenge! Pull hard! Hold the rope! Dig in your heels! Fall down softly! Ha ha, everyone is on the grass!
segments.subtitleJa: スピード チャレンジ！ つよく ひいて！ つなを もって！ かかとで ふんばって！ やさしく たおれて！ あはは、みんな くさの うえ！
segments.subtitleEn: Speed challenge! Pull hard! Hold the rope! Dig in your heels! Fall down softly! Ha ha, everyone is on the grass!

segments.say: Repeat after me. Who's winning?
segments.subtitleJa: まねして いってね。「どっちが かっているの？」
segments.subtitleEn: Repeat after me. Who's winning?

segments.say: The red team is.
segments.subtitleJa: 「赤チームだよ。」
segments.subtitleEn: The red team is.

segments.say: Everyone is pulling hard!
segments.subtitleJa: 「みんな いっしょうけんめい ひっぱってる！」
segments.subtitleEn: Everyone is pulling hard!

segments.say: Your turn! Pick a team color. Blue? Green? Yellow? Now answer me. Who's winning? The yellow team is!
segments.subtitleJa: あなたの ばん！ チームの いろを えらんで。青？ みどり？ きいろ？ こたえてね。Who's winning? The yellow team is！
segments.subtitleEn: Your turn! Pick a team color. Blue? Green? Yellow? Now answer me. Who's winning? The yellow team is!

segments.say: Quiz time! Who's winning? Which answer is right? A, The red team is. Or B, The red team does. Think!
segments.subtitleJa: クイズ！ Who's winning? ただしい こたえは どっち？ A「The red team is.」 B「The red team does.」 かんがえて！
segments.subtitleEn: Quiz time! Who's winning? Which answer is right? A, The red team is. Or B, The red team does. Think!

segments.say: It's A! Who is winning? The red team is. Short, simple, and right. You're a winner, too!
segments.subtitleJa: こたえは A！ Who is winning? The red team is。みじかくて、かんたんで、ただしい。あなたも チャンピオン！
segments.subtitleEn: It's A! Who is winning? The red team is. Short, simple, and right. You're a winner, too!

segments.say: Super job! You can ask Who's winning, answer The red team is, and say Congratulations to the winners. Next, talk with Birimo! ビリモ と おはなし してね. Bye-bye!
segments.subtitleJa: よく できました！ Who's winning? と きいて、The red team is. と こたえて、かった チームに Congratulations! と いえるね。このあと ビリモと おはなし してね。ばいばい！
segments.subtitleEn: Super job! You can ask Who's winning, answer The red team is, and say Congratulations to the winners. Next, talk with Birimo! Bye-bye!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today is Sports Day on the Plains, and you are the sports reporters. Here's your microphone! A reporter tells everyone what's happening now. Today's sentences are: Haru is running. Riko is cheering. Say them with me. Haru is running. Riko is cheering. Excellent! For two people, use are. Kiko and Birimo are jumping rope. Start with Look! to get attention. And add your feelings. What a race! リポーターに なって、いま おきている ことを みんなに つたえよう。 Now, phonics review. Rainbow. Rain and bow. Butterfly. Butter and fly. Ladybug. Lady and bug. Firefly. Fire and fly. A firefly glows at night! Here's a reporter tip. Speak loudly, speak clearly, and smile. At the end, say, Back to you! That means, now it's your turn. Let's say it. Back to you! OK, reporters. The relay is starting!

phonics.tipJa: I am → I'm、he is → he's、she is → she's、it is → it's。' （アポストロフィ）は きえた もじの しるし だよ。

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we're visiting a painter's studio on the plains. There are so many paintings on the walls! I'm pretending to be the painter. Let's talk about the pictures. Today's sentence is: In the picture, a boy is reading. Say it with me. In the picture, a boy is reading. Great! Start with In the picture. Then say who is doing what. You can add There's. There's a dog next to him. え を せつめい するときは、In the picture, からはじめよう。 Now, new phonics. I am becomes I'm. He is becomes he's. She is becomes she's. It is becomes it's. The little mark is called an apostrophe. It shows that a letter is missing. Here's a tip for talking about pictures. You can say what you think, too. I think she's happy. Let's say it. I think she's happy. OK, let's look at the first painting together!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! The painter has a very big picture today. It shows a festival on the plains. There are so many people in it! When a picture is big, tell us where to look. Today's sentence is: On the left, two girls are dancing. Say it with me. On the left, two girls are dancing. Great! Then, on the right, they're eating lunch. And in the middle, there's a big tree. ひだりは on the left、みぎは on the right、まんなかは in the middle だよ。 Left, middle, right. Talk about the picture in that order. It's easy for listeners. Now, phonics. They are, they're. We are, we're. You are, you're. The a in are is missing. And let's review. She is, she's. Be careful! They're sounds like there, but the spelling is different. Here's a tip. If your friend can't find something, help them. It's on the left, next to the tree. Let's look at the big picture now!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today we're reading the Plains Newspaper. There's a big photo on the front page. Let's talk about it. Today's sentence is: What's happening in this picture? Say it with me. What's happening in this picture? Good! What's means what is. To answer, say who is doing what. Some people are cleaning the park. しゃしんで なにが おきているか、～ing で こたえよう。 You can give a reason, too. They're cleaning because the wind blew the trash everywhere. Because tells us why. Now, phonics. What is, what's. That is, that's. There is, there's. Where is, where's. The i in is goes away, so we write an apostrophe. Here's a talking tip. When you hear a nice idea, say, That's a good idea! Let's say it. That's a good idea! OK, open the newspaper. What's happening today?

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! Let's play Spot the Difference. Kiko has one picture, and Haru has another. They look the same, but there are five differences. Today's sentence is: In my picture, the cat is sleeping. Say it with me. In my picture, the cat is sleeping. Great! To tell a difference, say, In your picture, it isn't sleeping. It's eating. Isn't means is not. 「わたしの えでは」は In my picture、「あなたの えでは」は In your picture だよ。 For two or more, use aren't. The boys aren't running. Now, phonics. Is not, isn't. Are not, aren't. Do not, don't. Does not, doesn't. The o in not is missing. That's why we write n-apostrophe-t. Here's a game tip. When you find a difference, shout, Found one! Let's shout. Found one! OK, look closely. Ready, go!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! It's the Picture Talk Show at the studio. Each of you will talk about one picture. A good picture talk has three parts. First, say In the picture and what's happening. Next, people and what they're doing. Last, what you think. Today's sentences are: In the picture, it's raining. People are running. Say them with me. In the picture, it's raining. People are running. Excellent! Then add one more. A girl is holding an umbrella. I think she's kind. 3つの 文と、さいごに I think ～. で じぶんの かんがえ だよ。 Now, phonics review. I am, I'm. They are, they're. Is not, isn't. Let us, let's. Where did the letters go? The apostrophe tells you! Here's a tip for presenting. Point to the picture when you talk. Then everyone can follow you. Start with, Let's look at my picture. OK, presenters, are you ready? Let's start the show!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Oh no, look outside. Drip, drop, drip, drop. It's raining on the plains. We can't play outside today. Today's sentence is: It's raining. We're staying inside. Say it with me. It's raining. We're staying inside. Great! For weather, say It's and an i-n-g word. It's raining. It's snowing. てんきは It's raining. の ように いうよ。 We're means we are. We're playing cards in the tent. A rainy afternoon can be fun, too! Now, new phonics. Rainy. Cloudy. Windy. Sunny. Listen to the end. Ee, ee, ee, ee. When y is at the end of a long word, it says ee. ながい ことばの おわりの y は「イー」だよ。 Here's a rainy day tip. When you hear the rain getting louder, say, Listen! The rain is getting stronger. Let's say it. Listen! The rain is getting stronger. OK, everyone, let's get cozy in the tent and play a game!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! The rain stopped. Let's go outside. Everything is wet and shiny. Look up! What can you see? Today's sentence is: Look! A rainbow is coming out. Say it with me. Look! A rainbow is coming out. Wonderful! Coming out means appearing. We can also say, The sky is getting brighter. Getting means it's changing little by little. だんだん かわっていく ようすは getting で いうよ。 Can you name the colors of the rainbow? Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. Now, phonics. Sky. Fly. Dry. Why. Listen to the end. Eye, eye, eye, eye. In short words with one beat, y at the end says eye. Last time, we learned rainy. Rainy says ee. Sky says eye. みじかい ことばの おわりの y は「アイ」だよ。 Here's a tip. When you see something beautiful, say, How beautiful! Let's say it. How beautiful! OK, put on your boots. Let's walk to the rainbow!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Wow, look at this field. It's full of yellow sunflowers! They're so big. Let's walk through the field. Today's sentence is: The sunflowers are growing tall. Say it with me. The sunflowers are growing tall. Great! Growing means getting bigger. You can compare, too. They're taller than me! And look closely. A bee is visiting the flowers. いきものや しょくぶつの ようすも ～ing で いえるよ。 Sunflowers love the sun. That's why they're called sunflowers. Sun and flower! Now, phonics. Yellow. Yes. Yard. Yawn. Listen to the beginning. Yeh, yuh, yuh. At the start of a word, y says yuh. ことばの はじめの y は「イェ」。 So y has different sounds. Sunny says ee. Sky says eye. Yellow says yuh. Here's a tip. When something is bigger than you, say, Wow, it's taller than me! Let's say it. Wow, it's taller than me! OK, let's find the tallest sunflower in the field!

lessons.teacherScript: Good evening, everyone! It's night on the plains. The campfire is warm, and the sky is very dark. Shh, let's talk quietly. Look up. Today's sentence is: The stars are shining. Say it softly with me. The stars are shining. Beautiful! The moon is rising over the hill. Rising means going up. よるの ようすも ～ing で しずかに いえるよ。 The plains have no city lights, so we can see thousands of stars. Can you find a shooting star? Now, phonics. Sleepy. Starry. These say ee. Shy says eye. Young says yuh. Three sounds of y! Where is the y? At the start, it says yuh. At the end of a long word, ee. At the end of a short word, eye. Here's a tip for bedtime. When you're tired, say, I'm getting sleepy. Good night! Let's whisper it. I'm getting sleepy. Good night! OK, let's lie down on the blanket and count the stars.

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! We've had many adventures on the plains. Tonight, let's write a Plains Diary in the tent, and read it to each other. A diary starts with Today. Today's sentence is: Today, I'm writing my diary in the tent. Say it with me. Today, I'm writing my diary in the tent. Great! Then write two more sentences. It's windy outside. My friends are sleeping. And add your feelings with because. I'm happy because I saw a rainbow. 日記は Today, から はじめて、いまの ようすと きもちを かこう。 Now, phonics review. Yes. Yeh. Happy. Windy. Ee. Fly. Eye. And remember, in a diary for sharing, you don't need to write your real name or address. OK, take out your pencils!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Let's play the Gesture Game. One person acts something out without words. Everyone else guesses what they're doing. To guess, ask a question. Today's sentences are: Are you swimming? No! I'm flying! Say them with me. Are you swimming? No! I'm flying! Great! If the guess is right, say, Yes, I am! If it's wrong, say, No, I'm not. I'm flying! はずれのときは No! I'm ～ing! で こたえよう。 You can ask about another person, too. Is he dancing? Yes, he is! Is she sleeping? No, she isn't! Now, phonics review. Swimming and hopping. Double the letter. Dancing. Drop the e. Flying. Just add i-n-g. Three rules again! Here's a game tip. When someone guesses right, say, You got it! Let's say it. You got it! OK, who wants to act first? No talking, only gestures!

lessons.teacherScript: Hi, everyone! There's a big kite festival on the plains today. There are so many people! Let's play Who Is It? Describe one person, and your friends find them. Today's sentences are: She's wearing a red hat. She's holding a kite. Say them with me. She's wearing a red hat. She's holding a kite. Wonderful! Wearing is for clothes, hats and glasses. Holding is for things in your hands. wearing は みに つけている もの、holding は てに もっている もの だよ。 You can also say what they're not wearing. He isn't wearing a hat. He's wearing glasses. Then ask, Who is it? Don't say mean things about people. OK, look at the crowd. Who is it?

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Today you're the artist. Draw a picture of the plains, and write three sentences about it. Today's sentence is: In my picture, Birimo is eating a sandwich. Say it with me. In my picture, Birimo is eating a sandwich. Great! Then add two more sentences. He's sitting under a sunflower. There's a rainbow in the sky. えを かいたら、In my picture, から 3つの 文を かこう。 Remember the rules for writing. Start with a capital letter. End with a period. Leave a space between words. Now, phonics review. Sunflower. Rainbow. Two words in one. It is, it's. Sit, sitting. We can use everything from this world! Here's a tip. Check your sentences with a friend. Ask, Can you read my sentences? Let's say it. Can you read my sentences? OK, take out your crayons. Let's draw and write!

lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! This is our last day on the Windy Plains. Let's have a goodbye picnic on the hill, and review everything. First, ask your friends, What are you doing? Then answer, I'm eating. I'm flying a kite. Say it with me. What are you doing? Great! Next, report something exciting. Look! A feather is falling from the sky. Remember, every day is for habits, and now is for right now. この ワールドでは、いま している ことを ～ing で いう れんしゅうを したね。 We learned place words, picture talk and cheering words, too. Behind. Between. In the picture. Keep going! Now, phonics review. Windy. Ee. Sky. Eye. Yellow. Yeh. Running. Double the n! Excellent! Here's a tip. At the end of a trip, tell your friends, This was so much fun! Let's say it. This was so much fun! OK, let's spread the blanket. Wait, what's that in the sky?

lessons.teacherScript: Congratulations, everyone! This is the last lesson of World 15. ワールド15 さいごの レッスンだよ。 First, speed challenge! Look! Stop! Come here! Go! Run! Hop! Swim! Fly! Great! Now, it's the World 15 live show on the plains stage. You are the reporters. Tell the audience what's happening right now. Today's sentence is: We're having a great time on the plains! Say it with me. We're having a great time on the plains! Wonderful! A good live report has three parts. Start with Look! Then say who is doing what. Look! Haru is flying a kite. Riko and Kiko are dancing. Then cheer. Keep going, everyone! Now, the last phonics review. Making. Running. Grasshopper. They're. Happy. Amazing! And look, the wind feather is glowing. It's showing us old stone ruins on the map. Where are we going next? But first, your live show. Speak loudly and smile. You can do it!
